pr.body: Implemented the documented pure function in retry_budget.py. Validation occurs before exhausted-attempt returns and rejects bool, float, and out-of-range integers. Backoff saturates without huge power construction; Retry-After remains a minimum and is not capped; next-start budget comparison is strict. Extended test_retry_budget.py using unittest only. Final checks: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest -v (10 passed), git diff --check (passed). Baseline: all 3 original tests errored because the implementation raised NotImplementedError. No third-party dependencies or open issues.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded retries with strict input validation, saturated exponential backoff, an uncapped Retry-After floor, and budget boundary enforcement. Before: retry_delay was an unimplemented stub; now: all specified return, error, and boundary behavior is covered by passing tests.
pr.title: Implement bounded retry budget scheduling
